description: The Biological Technologies Office (BTO) of the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) will host the BTO Innovation Opportunity Fair (BIO Fair) event for prospective proposers on June 5, 2026, in Tysons, Virginia. Advance registration is required for in-person and virtual event. There will be no on-site registration. The event will include overview presentations by DARPA personnel, including BTO Program Managers.
